def main():
    m = sys.argv[1]
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    out = sys.stdout.buffer
    if m == 'c':
        c = [b'L' + lzma.compress(data, format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=F),
             b'B' + bz2.compress(data, 9)]
        out.write(min(c, key=len))

            out.write(bz2.decompress(b))
